title: The Handmaid's Tale
author: Margaret Atwood
summary: In a future theocracy where fertile women are assigned to elite households as breeders, one Handmaid recalls her old life while she carries out her role. Small acts of defiance are dangerous.
readIf: you want a chilling, intimate dystopia that feels frighteningly plausible.
skipIf: you want comfort reading, because the book's depiction of control over women's bodies is disturbing and its ending is unresolved.

pairings.reason: The older model of the state-run nightmare, focused on language and surveillance.
Another thoughtful dystopian novel by a woman about survival and belief when society breaks down.
A short, young-adult look at a seemingly calm society with a terrible secret.
